title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 20: the new moon feast, the sign of the arrows and the parting of David and Jonathan.

questions.text: What did David tell Jonathan was coming the next day?
questions.explanation: David said, "Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king."

questions.text: Where was Jonathan to say David had asked leave to go?
questions.explanation: Jonathan was to say that David asked leave to run to Bethlehem his city for the yearly sacrifice of the family.

questions.text: By which stone was David to remain?
questions.explanation: Jonathan told David to come to the place where he had hidden and remain by the stone Ezel.

questions.text: How many arrows did Jonathan say he would shoot?
questions.explanation: Jonathan said, "I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark."

questions.text: What did it mean if Jonathan told the boy, "The arrows are beyond you"?
questions.explanation: Jonathan said that if he told the boy the arrows were beyond him, David should go his way, for Yahweh had sent him away.

answers.text: David should hide one more day
David must come to the king's table

questions.text: Who sat by Saul's side at the meal?
questions.explanation: At the meal Jonathan stood up and Abner sat by Saul's side, but David's place was empty.

questions.text: Why did Saul say nothing about David's empty seat on the first day?
questions.explanation: Saul thought, "Something has happened to him. He is not clean."

answers.text: He thought David was not clean
He thought David was ill with fever
He thought David was with Samuel
He did not see that the seat was empty

questions.text: What did Saul do when Jonathan asked why David should be put to death?
questions.explanation: Saul cast his spear at Jonathan to strike him, and Jonathan knew his father was determined to put David to death.

answers.text: He cast his spear at Jonathan
He left the table and wept

questions.text: What did Jonathan do on the second day of the month?
questions.explanation: Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger and ate no food the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David.

questions.text: When David and Jonathan wept together, who wept the most?
questions.explanation: They kissed one another and wept one with another, and David wept the most.
